1.text: Mutima wanjye, himbaza Uwiteka,Uwiteka Mana yanjye urakomeye cyane,Wambaye icyubahiro no gukomera.

2.text: Wambara umucyo nk'umwenda,Usanzura ijuru nk'umwenda ukinze mu ihema.

3.text: Ashinga inkingi z'insenge ze ku mazi,Ibicu abigira igare rye,Agendera ku mababa y'umuyaga.

4.text: Agira abamarayika be imiyaga,Abagaragu be abagira umuriro waka.

5.text: Yashyiriyeho imfatiro z'isi,Kugira ngo itanyeganyega iteka.

6.text: Wayambitse inyanja nk'umwenda,Amazi atwikīra imisozi miremire.

7.text: Ahungishwa no guhana kwawe,Yirukishwa no guhinda kw'inkuba yawe,

8.text: (Imisozi ishyirwa hejuru, ibikombe birīka),Agera ahantu wayategekeye.

9.text: Wayategekeye ingabano atabasha kurenga,Kugira ngo atagaruka akarengera isi.

10.text: Yohereza amasōko mu bikombe,Imigezi itemba hagati y'imisozi.

11.text: Inyobwa n'inyamaswa zose zo mu ishyamba,Imparage na zo zishira inyota.

12.text: Inyoni n'ibisiga byo mu kirere biba kuri iyo migezi,Bijwigirira mu mashami.

13.text: Ivubira imisozi imvura ivuye ku nsenge ze,Ubutaka buhazwa n'imbuto z'imirimo yawe.

14.text: Amereza inka ubwatsi,Ameza imboga zo kugaburira abantu,Kugira ngo abakurire umutsima mu butaka,

15.text: Na vino yishimisha imitima y'abantu,Ngo aboneranishe mu maso habo amavuta,Kandi ngo umutsima uhe imitima y'abantu gukomera.

16.text: Ibiti by'Uwiteka birahaga,Imyerezi y'i Lebanoni yateye.

17.text: Iyo inyoni n'ibisiga byarikaho ibyari,Inzoyo ifite inzu yayo ku miberoshi.

18.text: Imisozi miremire ni iy'ihene zo mu ishyamba,Ibitare ni ubuhungiro bw'inkwavu.

19.text: Yashyiriyeho ukwezi kumenyekanisha ibihe,Izuba rizi igihe rirengera.

20.text: Uzana umwijima rikaba ijoro,Ni bwo inyamaswa zo mu ishyamba zose zisohoka zomboka.

21.text: Imigunzu y'intare yivugira umuhīgo wayo,Ku Mana ni ho ishakira ibyokurya byayo.

22.text: Izuba ryarasa zikagenda,Zikaryama mu masenga yazo.

23.text: Abantu bagasohoka bakajya ku mirimo yabo,No ku muruho wabo bakageza nimugoroba.

24.text: Uwiteka, erega imirimo yawe ni iy'uburyo bwinshi!Yose wayikoresheje ubwenge,Isi yuzuye ubutunzi bwawe.

25.text: Dore iriya nyanja nini ngari,Irimo ibigenda bitabarika,Inyamaswa ntoya n'inini.

26.text: Ni ho inkuge zigenda,Ni ho Lewiyatani iri waremeye kuyikiniramo.

27.text: Ibyo byose bigutegerereza,Kugira ngo ubigaburire ibyokurya byabyo igihe cyabyo.

28.text: Biyora ibyo ubihaye,Upfumbatura igipfunsi cyawe bigahaga ibyiza.

29.text: Uhisha mu maso hawe bigahinda imishyitsi,Ubikuramo umwuka bigapfa,Bigasubira mu mukungugu wabyo.

30.text: Wohereza umwuka wawe bikaremwa,Ubutaka ubusubizaho ubugingo bushya.

31.text: Icyubahiro cy'Uwiteka gihoreho iteka,Uwiteka yishimira imirimo ye.

32.text: Ni we ureba isi igahinda umushyitsi,Akora ku misozi igacumba.

33.text: Nzajya ndirimbira Uwiteka nkiriho,Nzajya ndirimbira Imana yanjye ishimwe ngifite ubugingo.

34.text: Ibyo nibwiye biyinezeze,Nanjye nzajya nishimira Uwiteka.

35.text: Abanyabyaha barimbuke bashire mu isi,Ababi be kubaho ukundi.Mutima wanjye, himbaza Uwiteka.Haleluya.
